                                                                                                    20-10-3
  RESOLUTION AMENDING THE BUDGET OF THE MONTGOMERY COUNTY CAPITAL
   PROJECTS FUND APPROPRIATING FUNDS RECEIVED FROM THE GOVERNOR’S
                            LOCAL GOVERNMENT SUPPORT GRANT

        WHEREAS, Tennessee Public Chapter No. 651, Title 111-22, Items 10.33-34 established the
Governor’s Local Government Support Grants (LGSG) which provides funding that local governments
may request; and
        WHEREAS, Montgomery County is in need offunding for projects that meet all ofthe
requirements of Tennessee Public Chapter No. 651, Title 111-22, 10.33-34; and
       WHEREAS, the Montgomery County Sheriff’s Office and Montgomery County Emergency
Medical Services have requested to use these funds for the purchase ofitems necessary to the operations
of their respective departments; and

        WHEREAS, it is agreed Montgomery County will comply with the Terms ofAgreement
prescribed by the State Department ofFinance and Administration; and
        WHEREAS, the Montgomery County Sheriff’s Office will use these funds for the purchase of
six (6) marked patrol vehicles, three (3) unmarked vehicles, and one (1) transport van for a total cost of
four hundred seventy-three thousand six hundred eighty-nine dollars ($473,689); and
      WHEREAS, the Montgomery County Emergency Medical Service’s current Onboard Mobile
Gateway (0MG) system will lose support as of December 31,2020; and
        WHEREAS, the cost of replacement ofthe 0MG will be fifty-three thousand two hundred
dollars ($53,200).

        NOW, THEREFORE BE if RESOLVED by the Montgomery County Board of
Commissioners assembled in regular session on this 12th day of October 2020 that the Fiscal Year 2021
budget of the Capital Projects fund be amended using funds from the Local Government Support Grant in
the amount of five hundred twenty-six thousand eight hundred eighty-nine dollars ($526,889) to be
appropriated for the purchase of the items as mentioned above for the Montgomery County Sheriff’s
Office and Emergency Medical Services in the accounts as follows:
171-91 130-00000-91-57180-TR600 (Motor Vehicles)                                    $473,689.00
171-91 140-00000-91-57090-TR800 (Data Processing Equipment)                         $ 53,200.00
                                               TOTALS                               $ 526,889.00


        Duly approved this    12
                                th   day of October2020.
